shots.characters: Kai (walking away from camera at a walk, 1.5 m/s), umbrella crowd on both pavements
shots.lighting: Neon blade signs, puddle glow, near-camera rain streaks; a cool rim light rides with Kai so he reads against the asphalt; Helix rings at the vanishing point.
shots.sound: Rain bed, distant traffic hum, footsteps; piano motif enters at the cut.
shots.notes: g1: camera keys are offsets from Kai's root (anchor), 14 m back and 7 m up to an over-the-shoulder 2.9 m behind him; focus on Kai. Kai walks via the analog stick (0.36 = walk, not the 3.1 m/s jog of KeyW). Run-time staging: shop-window canvases blurred and desaturated, the ambient passing train hidden, a denser near-camera rain layer (a second Rain from the game's own class), a cyan rim light following Kai.

preview.note: Crane reads; the m1 shop-window canvases (bright product squares) stay visible on the left at 1080p.

shots.beat: The toy that un-falls: a child drops a toy, it lands, then rises back into her hand along the same arc; she looks up at Kai's glowing wrist.

shots.characters: The station child (yellow coat, red boots) facing Kai, who stands just off frame right; her mother and the pavement walkers are moved off the camera's side
shots.lighting: Low child-eye-level angle from the shop side: the wet street, lit windows and neon strips of the far side behind her; the dialogue rig on her face; a cyan glow from Kai's band rises on her as she speaks.
shots.notes: g1: the toy loop runs on game time (4 s): the setup waits for cycle 3.5, so hand 0.5-1.5 s, fall 1.5-2.1, floor 2.1-2.9, un-fall 2.9-3.5 (trail glow scaled down), line at 3.6. preview.note: Toy falls, lands, rises (visible at the middle frame). The shop canvases behind her are still bright; a passer-by may cross at the head.

shots.beat: Kai's wrist: the Chronolith band glows, then flares as the street pulls toward one moment; the child watches it, then the focus racks to the band.
